spectral_to_graph.description: Spectral analyzer outputs 2D numpy array consumed by graph builder

graph_to_harmonic.description: Graph builder outputs NetworkX graph consumed by harmonic analyzer
graph_to_harmonic.data_format: networkx.MultiDiGraph with temporal and harmonic edges

fundamentals_to_onset.description: Harmonic analyzer outputs fundamental notes consumed by onset detector
fundamentals_to_onset.data_format: List[Dict] with keys: node_id, frequency, note, intensity, time_seconds, confidence

graph_to_onset.description: Graph builder outputs graph also consumed by onset detector for temporal flow analysis

onsets_to_midi.description: Onset detector outputs note events consumed by MIDI generator
onsets_to_midi.data_format: List[Dict] with keys: onset_time_seconds, duration_seconds, velocity, note_name, midi_note

midi_to_filesystem.description: MIDI generator writes output file to filesystem

orchestrator_coordination.description: Pipeline orchestrator coordinates all components in sequence

internal_only_services.description: All services are internal (CLI tool, no external API)

audio_to_midi_transcription.justification: CLI tool with no network exposure
